title: Integral over (a,b) of the lower left Dini derivative of a nondecreasing function is at most G(b) − G(a) (parent Step 7 / (5d), Lebesgue's theorem)
statement: Let G : ℝ → ℝ be nondecreasing and let a ≤ b. Let D(t) := liminf_{k→0+} ofReal((G(t) − G(t − k))/k) ∈ [0, ∞], with the liminf along 𝓝[>] 0 in [0, ∞]. Then ∫⁻_{(a,b)} D(t) dt ≤ ofReal(G(b) − G(a)), where ∫⁻ is the lower Lebesgue integral with respect to Lebesgue measure dt.
lean_statement: ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ, Monotone G → ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, liminf (fun k : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((G t - G (t - k)) / k)) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (G b - G a)
